semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Sinomach Diamond (Henan) Co., Ltd. specializes in superhard materials, including diamond substrates and thermal interface materials, which are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Sinomach Diamond (Henan) Co., Ltd. focuses on the development and supply of superhard materials, particularly diamond substrates and thermal interface materials, which are essential in semiconductor applications. The company aims to enhance the competitive advantages of the diamond industry chain, contributing to various stages of semiconductor production.
capabilities: Thermal interface materials for heat management
Scribe tools and dicing blades for wafer processing

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and is part of a larger group focused on the high-quality development of the superhard materials industry.
